notes.title: Update 1.1: Choose Your Fruit!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812890/Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio_Fruit_Girls_2/][img]https://i.imgur.com/hCczyMl.png[/img][/url]

The biggest news in this Update is that you can now navigate a LOT EASIER between each girl and the [b]Fruit Girl Selection Menu[/b] in the [b]Photobook[/b]. Besides that, we corrected a couple of bugs and improved UI elements.

Remember that our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/21384/CUMplete_Pack/]CUMplete Pack[/url][/b] contains the new game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1812890/Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio_Fruit_Girls_2/]HJPS: FG2[/url][/b], and everything from the first game, including [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1504460/Hentai_Jigsaw_Photo_Studio_Fruit_Girls/]HJPS: FG1[/url][/b], [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1595700/The_Horny_Bard_Soundtrack/]The Horny Bard Soundtrack[/url][/b], [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1662880/The_Handjob_Artificer_Art_Pack/]The Handjob Artificer Art Pack[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1772330/The_Lustful_Magician_Erotic_Tapes/]The Lustful Magician Erotic Tapes[/url][/b]. All of it with a permanent [b]20% discount[/b] that stacks with any sale discount!

Below is the complete changelog:

[b][u]PUZZLE[/u][/b]
[list][*]Now the [b]Back[/b] button of the [b]Puzzles[/b] correctly returns to the [b]Photobook[/b] page of the girl that you were playing with.
[*]The artworks of the [b]Fruit Salad[/b] are now correctly dimensioned.
[*]The [b]Next[/b] button of the [b]Fruit Salad Level 4[/b] now redirect you to the [b]Fruit Girl Selection Menu[/b] or the next playable [b]Puzzle[/b].[/list]

[b][u]PHOTOBOOK[/u][/b]
[list][*]We added a simpler way for you to navigate between the different Fruit Girls. Now you can just click on the [b]Choose Your Girl[/b] button and get back to the [b]Fruit Girl Selection Menu[/b].
[*]The buttons of each girl in the [b]Fruit Girl Selection Menu[/b] now has a highlight on them.
[*]We standardize the layout of all the [b]Fruit Girls[/b] texts.
[*]All the artwork that opens each girl section now is ridden of the grayness that engulfed them.
[*]Now each [b]Fruit Girl[/b] section in the [b]Photobook[/b] have decorative stickers.[/list]

[b][u]STEAMWORKS[/u][/b]
[list][*]We changed the icon of the game.
[*]The [b]Cloud Save[/b] is supposed to be correctly working now. Let us know.[/list]
